headline: PLDT Unit Plans Acquisition of Ayala Data Center Assets Ahead of Proposed REIT Listing
summary: A subsidiary of Philippine telecommunications firm PLDT Inc is negotiating to acquire Ayala Group's data center portfolio to strengthen assets ahead of a planned 2027 REIT initial public offering.
why: PLDT is the largest telecommunications conglomerate in the Philippines, expanding digital infrastructure assets.
